tei:div.tei:p: "$ (639)༄༅// mgon po gri gug dpa' gcig gi sgrub thabs bzlas lung 'bogs tshul dang bcas pa bzhugs so/// /

(640)༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ nag po chen po sgrub pa'i thabs// nyung gsal byin rlabs bka' babs dang*// a ti sha yi man ngag ni// bcos slad bral ba 'di ltar lags// skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon tu btang ste// stong pa la cung zad mnyam par bzhag /oṃ swa bhā wa/ sogs brjod/ padma dang nyi ma'i steng du mi ro bkan pa'i gdan la rang skad cig gis dpal ldan ma hā kā la sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin dang mtshungs pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod pa khrag gang thugs kar 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs shing ljags bskyod pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ sbom thung yan lag hrags shing gsus khyim che ba/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis/ me tshan drag po 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs pa'o// thugs kar raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du/ hūm̐ mthing nag de las 'od zer 'phros/ shar phyogs nas rgyal ba mi bskyod pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ rang gi spyi bor rigs bdag gi tshul (641)du bzhugs par gyur/ yang hūm̐ las 'od zer smug nag shin tu tsha ba 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sems can gdug pa can thams cad kyi lus rnams gdungs shing sems ngan pa can thams cad bsregs par gyur/ hūm̐ gi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba bsgoms la/ oṃ ma hā kā la ha na ha na badzre ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci nus su bzlas pa'i mthar/ dpal mgon pos bdag gi dgra lha dang srung ma chen po mdzod la/ spyi dang khyad par gyis bstan pa skyong ba dang*/ bdag dang sems can rnams la gnod byed thams cad 'dul zhing*/ phrin las rnam pa bzhi 'grub pa dang*/ bar chad bsrung zhing*/ yid la bsam pa'i don thams cad 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ dpal mgon po khyed kyi go 'phang thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes bdag bskyed kyi lha la gsol ba drag tu btab cing*/

ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ dge ba bsngo ba'o// bza' btung nam byed pa'i phud nas mi chung tsam bcad la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ ma hā kā la badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs/ snying po'i mthar/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ btags pa lan gsum gyis 'bul/ oṃ (642)muḥ zhes gshegs su gsol/ khyad par gyi mchod pa ni/ dus bzang thams cad dang*/ khyad par nyer dgu'i mtshan mo/ mdun tu maṇḍal nag po gru gsum zhig byas la/ khrag dang chang gis byugs/ tshom bu nag po zhig bkod/ de'i mdun du bshos bu'i gtor ma lag len ltar gsum bshams/ mchod pa sna lnga gcig dang*/ mchod yon/ me tog nag po'i phung po/ spos sbyor ram/ gu gul/ dpal 'bar gsum rnams bshams/ bdag bskyed yi dam mam/ gong du bstan pa'i mgon po nyid sngon du 'gro bas mchod rdzas rnams spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlab/ gtor ma a mṛ ta sa bsang/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ /oṃ stong par gyur/ āḥthod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba/ hūm̐ sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas gang ba/ hoḥye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ lan gsum brjod/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas/ mgon po nag po 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ maṇḍal gyi tshom bu'i steng du 'khod pa ni/ dpal ldan ma hā kā la nas/ hūm̐ mthing nag go /mchod yon nas/ shabda 'i bar gyis mchod/ srin gzugs ma'i sho lo ka dang pos bstod/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ la dmigs nas bzlas pa cung zad bya/ gtor ma dang po gsol bar dmigs la/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas rgya cher spel/ snying po'i mthar/ i daṃ pa ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan bdun gyis bstab/ bdag bskyed kyi skabs bzhin gsol ba drag tu btab/ gtor ma gnyis pa'ang sngar dang 'dra ba las/

snying po'i mthar/ a kā ro btag pas 'bul/ 'di la 'dod don mi zhu/ gsum pa yang nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya sngon tu 'gro bas/ oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa/ sa pa ri wā re bhyaḥ na massarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te/ oṃ sambha ra sambha ra hūm̐/ zhes lan nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam gyis 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo// sbos sbyor bsreg cing me tog re re nas gtor ma la 'bul ba dang*/ snying po kho na bzla bar bya'o// bstod pa srin gzugs ma yongs rdzogs kyi mthar/ 'das dang ma byon da ltar gyi// bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa// nag po khyed ni yin pa ste// gdug pa tshar gcod 'jigs pa'i gzugs// (643)dbu skra kham nag gyen brdzes pa// steng gi lha tshogs 'jigs par byed// spyan bsgrad ljags 'dril mche gtsigs nas// bar gyi lha tshogs bsreg par mdzad// g.yas na gri gug bsnams pa ni// dgra bgegs 'dul zhing bdud mgo gcod// g.yon na thod pa bsnams pa ni// gnon sems can gyi snying khrag gsol// khros pas zhabs gnyis brdab pa yis// ma rungs rnams kyis lus la nyed// nag po che la phyag 'tshal 'dud// gang la bya ba rdul du rlog /ces sogs phrin las bcol ci zhes bya/ dpal 'bar gsum yang sbar te/ oṃ ma hā pra dī pe hūm̐/ zhes lan gsum brjod cing*/ gtor ma rnams la re re btsugs/ bzod gsol gyi mthar gtor ma khang steng ngam dur khrod du bskyal/ oṃ muḥ zhes tshom bu bsdu'o// tshul 'dis sngags 'bum phrag gcig gis bsnyen pa 'grub par bshad/ 'bum phrag bcu gsum gyis steng gdon gyis zin pa'ang thar bar the tshom med ces gsung*/ 'bum phrag sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis ni/ shin tu skal pa dman yang las thams cad 'grub ces bshad la/ 'on kyang de ltar 'bum phrag bco brgyad bsnyen tshad du mdzad cing*/ de nas sgrub pa la 'jug par 'dod na/ bris sku mdun du bkram la/ maṇḍal ma gtogs gong gi mchod chog dang 'dra ba bya ba las/

khyad par ni mdun bskyed kyi bzlas pa kho na gtso bor byed cing*/ sngar gyi maṇḍal gyi tshab bris sku la byed pa dang*/ sngags phreng zhal nas zhal lte ba nas lte bar 'khor ba'i dmigs pa byed/ gtor ma gsum po sgrub pa ma thon par phyir mi gtong zhing*/ thun re re bzhin 'byor pa che na gsar pa re bshams/ min na kha gso// thun mtshams su gshegs gsol mi byed par bris sku la brtan bzhugs bya/ thun thams cad dam srod thun la thun gtor re re nges par gtong*/ tshul des 'bum phrag bco brgyad bzlas la/ sgrub pa'i grangs tshad theng bar byed do// 'tshub mang shugs drag khang thog 'char// glu len bya rog ā tsa ra// dar nag thog te 'o dod 'bod// phyi'i rtags su shes par bya// slob dpon 'ong nas gtam smra dang*// chos 'chad lung ston gdugs 'phub dang*// bandhe ston pa nang gi rtags// (644) mgon po'i sku ston gri gug dang*// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang ca co 'don// dngos grub ster bar rmi ba dang*// stag dang seṅge 'phyo ba dang*// shel gyi mchod rten bskor ba dang*// gtor chen khyer 'phrad 'grub pa'i rtags// mtshon cha'i char dang a tsa ra// 'khrug rgol du ba bzlog rtags so// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// snying po la/ badzre ṇa bdag la srungs shig srungs shig hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes 'khor lo 'khor ba'i tshul gyis dmigs pa gsal btab ste bzlas na/ nad gdon thams cad thon cing*/ srung ba dang*/ byin rlabs kyi mchog go /yang gdon 'dul na/ badzre ṇa bdag gam che ge mo la gnod par byed pa'i rgyal 'gong mā ra ya dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes bzla/ rgyal 'gong zhes par gang dgos spel/ yang badzre ṇa ba su puṣṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/ bdag gi 'byor ba puṣṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes pas longs spyod lhag par 'bul bar 'gyur la/ ā yu puṣṭiṃ tshe puṣṭiṃ zhes 'don pa spos na/ tshe sgrub kyi mchog yin la/

bsrung ba dang 'dre 'dul gtso bor phyi dro bzla zhing*/ longs spyod dang tshe spel ba gtso bor snga dro bzla'o// sgrub pa dang las sbyor gyi tshe/ zlog pa'i rtags byung ba/ oṃ ma hā kā la bī la ma hūm̐ hūm̐ ril rbad/ bu ni dza ma hā kā la trakshad siddhi ma ma du ti dzaḥ gling byin tshal/ snying nas dzaḥ dgra bo mā ra ya dzaḥdzaḥ zhes pa rgya tsa tsam bzlas pas spel bar 'gyur ro// drag po'i las sbyor ni/ sgrub pa'i dus kyi cho ga la 'don pa spos nas/ gtor ma dang sbyin sreg la brten pa'i dgra bsad cig yod de/ 'dir ma bris so// de'i tshe drag tu bskul ba'i tshig ni/ gang zhig dkon mchog gsum gnod dang*// bstan pa la gnod mtshams med byed// bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo 'di// phyi dus 'gyang bar ma 'jog par// bdag gis bsgo ba kun khug la// ling ga 'di la myur du khug /'di yi sha zo khrag la rol// rus pa klad pa nang khrol drongs// rigs rgyud rtsad nas chod la shog /mdza' bo kun dang phrol la shog /yang na 'di yi phyir 'brangs nas// til 'bru tsam du mdzad du gsol/ /ces brjod pa ste/ 'di ngo bo'i gsung yin no// zhes (645) sangs rgyas sgom pas gsungs so// bzlas lung bya ba'i tshul ni/ slob dpon gyi bya ba nyer dgu mchod pa bzhin las/ bzlas pa'i mtshams su lung sbyin te/ slob mas maṇḍal phul/ yan lag bdun pa bzang spyod bzhin bya/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rgyas par grub na rab/ ma grub na sangs rgyas chos dang ma tsam zhig bya/ mngon rtogs phog /sngags bzlas lung du sbyin pa tsam gyis don 'grub pa yin no// de nas slob dpon gyis cho ga'i lhag ma rnams bya/ sgrub thabs 'di lhad med shin tu yid ches dang ldan pa/ grang chung ba zhig snang bas 'brom ston pa yab sras kyi yig chung gnyis dang*/ sangs rgyas sgom pa'i gsal byed yig chung brten nas/ bsnyen pa dang sgrub pa'i tshul gsal bar bkod pa yin no// las sbyar ni de dag tu shes par bya'o// nag po chen po'i sgrub pa ni// kun dga'i nyams len snying po 'di// deng dus gzhan la ma grags kyang*// bdag gi bsod nams dpal las rnyed// gri gug dpa' gcig gi sgrub thabs bzlas lung la brten par grags pa'i man ngag bstan pa'i le tshan no// sgrub thabs rin 'byung las khol du phyung ba dge legs 'phel/// /
